9a2a8f43-6f74-4fc3-b25c-3e139b710002.title: Keybind Logic
9a2a8f43-6f74-4fc3-b25c-3e139b710002.description: Wire the input to one specific seat. It stays out of the seat hotbar and only responds to that occupant. The output supports logic, power, and bearings. Press E to bind any key and U to choose HOLD, TOGGLE, or PULSE. Requires keybind_bridge.dll on every player's client.

9a2a8f43-6f74-4fc3-b25c-3e139b710003.title: Mode Controller
9a2a8f43-6f74-4fc3-b25c-3e139b710003.description: A separate mode command block for Keybind Logic. A rising signal from a button, gate, sensor, or timer cycles HOLD → TOGGLE → PULSE. Connect its output to one or more Keybind Logic blocks. Optionally connect a seat and bind a keyboard key with E. U cycles manually.
